text: Hebr. I wil giue them for a moouing. , Deut.28. 25. cha.24. 9. , 2.Kin.21. 11.
Hebr. to aske of thy thy peace.
Or, against the mother citie, a yong man spoiling, &c. Or, aagainst the mother and the yong men.
Or, I will entreat the enemie for thee.
Eze.3.3. reuel.10.9. , Heb. thy Name is called vpon me.
